summary: M2-T1 Watch commission-gate live drill executed end-to-end against the deployed backend, and Grey Mirror Watch record UI validated as operator. Step A (3x back-to-back POST /api/portal/census/language-cognition/jobs {phase:'nope'} as analyst) returned 403/403/403; Step B (immediate retry) returned HTTP 429 with detail containing 'friction' and action id ma_gate_63fd3485b58f. Operator GET /api/portal/watch/state after Step B showed counts.gate_crossings=7, gate_refusals=7, gate_effects=1, verdicts=1, actions=1; protected_boundaries has exactly 3 entries (census.commission, census.plan, language_cognition.commission); a verdict row kind='verdict' detector='fast_violation' boundary='language_cognition.commission' actor='principal:6ab56dd58894abb269135ca3' is present, and a 'shape' action row is In effect with effect_verified=true; no 'password'/'secret' strings in response. Step C (further POSTs spaced 32-33 s) produced 3 more 403s (refusal count 8,9,10) and the 4th spaced attempt returned HTTP 409 with detail 'suspended by the Watch until 2026-09-29T08:21:20.015063Z (action ma_gate_0aa280248082). Reading your estate's records is unaffected.' Analyst reads remained unaffected: GET /api/portal/census/language-cognition/jobs -> 200 and GET /api/portal/census/overview -> 200. Post-Step-C operator watch/state shows contain action In effect, effect_verified=true, detector='slow_play', gate_effects=3 (was 1). M2-T2: operator benign GETs (overview, jobs list, single job lcj-f96c86a16312) all 200 and did NOT change counts.gate_crossings (10 before/after). One operator POST {phase:'nope'} returned 422 and correctly appeared as a refused crossing (final counts.gate_refusals=11, gate_crossings=11). Frontend: signed in as operator, navigated to /os/admin/greymirror/watch/record; ledger shows externally_steerable verdicts (Recorded) and 'contain'+'shape' actions (In effect) with correct timestamps and 'Commission-gate detection; effect receipts prove the gate enforced it' basis. Clicked 'Walk this →' on the contain row and the drawer opened with body containing 'Commission-gate detection'. No horizontal overflow at 1920x800 or 390x844.

critical.issue: Spec expects legacy GET /api/watch/state to return 200 unauthenticated with verdicts.entries containing ids starting 'mv_gate_' and verdict_class='externally_steerable'. Actual: unauthenticated call returns 401 ('Sign in to view your estate's census.'). With operator auth it returns 200 but verdicts.entries is EMPTY (0 gate entries). Gate verdicts (mv_gate_ccfd9202c812, mv_gate_adb54a6af141) are only surfaced via the new /api/portal/watch/state, not rolled up into legacy /api/watch/state. Note: 'no entry has action_class sever' is technically satisfied because there are no entries at all, but the positive requirement (entries include mv_gate_* with externally_steerable) is not met.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) /api/watch/state auth+empty: The new commission-gate ledger writes verdicts/actions into a per-tenant namespace consumed by services/watch/operational_reads.state_for (feeding /api/portal/watch/state). The legacy /api/watch/state rollup was not updated to include those files, so its verdicts.entries stays empty. Additionally the legacy route now requires session auth. Mitigation: extend the legacy rollup to include gate verdict/action files, or version the endpoint and update spec. 2) Header deck copy: watchRecordModel.js gmHeadDeck should be extended to display state.counts.gate_crossings and state.counts.gate_effects with labels 'gate crossings' and 'enforced effects'.
